New message in #sales:

dave: @lobu who owns the Globex account these days?

input.text: Hey Dave — I don't have a way to look up account ownership from here right now (no CRM/db query hooked up in this session). Could you pull Globex up in the Owletto UI and check the account owner field directly? If that's not showing what you expect, let me know and I can dig into why.
